section.44: The Book of the Merits of the Companions

44.name_native: The Book of the Merits of the Companions

hadiths.text: Abu Huraira reported:There are some distinguishing features of Banu Tamim which I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and my love for them is never on the decline after that and the words are: They are the bravest amongst people in the battlefield and there is no mention of (the word)" Dajjal
